1a842c4ef7: Real estate services on the Šibenik coast
3bf4b90b09: More than buying and selling. Since 2010 N24 has helped owners, buyers and investors on the Šibenik coast with the hard part of property: fragmented land, paperwork, permits and building.
246a49aff0: Turning many small plots with many owners into one plot you can build on.
335972140d: Along the Croatian coast, land is usually split into many small cadastral plots, often with owners who live abroad, owners who have died, or heirs nobody has traced. That is the main reason good building land stays stuck. N24 analyses the land, checks every record and brings the owners together, so investors can decide with real facts and buy one clean plot.
